input_law: all 1,722 ordered distinct nonidentity pairs on fixed E(F_47), centered rational coordinate lifts; the reduced-relation flag is excluded from construction decisions
local_policy: if centered x coordinates differ over Q, F_7, F_11 and both point-incidence rows have rank 2, enumerate all a1,a2,a3 residues at each auxiliary prime, solve a4,a6 locally, retain all nonsingular order-4 curves at 7 and order-6 curves at 11
skip_policy: retain same-x, local-x-collision and local-incidence-rank failures as explicit source rows with zero CRT candidates
crt_policy: for every lexicographically ordered pair of local gate witnesses, choose the unique centered k1,k2,k3 in [-38,38] with a_i=47*k_i matching both primes; solve a4,a6 rationally from both lifted-point equations
checks: exact coefficient congruences at 47,7,11; rational curve equation and discriminant; auxiliary group orders; rational P1+2P2 relation; source reduced relation used only for analysis
record: one row per source pair with every exclusion and local/CRT count, first rational-relation certificate, and complete CRT candidate-stream digest; gzip exact raw rows
resource: complete uncapped finite enumeration under this target-independent policy, no wall-time performance claim
claim_boundary: centered CRT representative policy on locally distinct x pairs; coefficient shifts and local-x collisions are separate amendments
